GDRFA · Amer

Visa & residency typing

New residence visas, renewals, cancellations, status change and family sponsorship applications, typed to GDRFA/Amer format and submitted through the authorised channel.

Visa & Emirates ID detail Ask about this

Covers

  • New residence visa and entry permit applications
  • Visa renewal, cancellation and status change
  • Family sponsorship — spouse, children, parents
  • Visa for widows and divorced women (1-year extension guidance)
  • Entry permit and status adjustment support
Bring

Passport copy, current visa or entry permit, sponsor’s passport and visa, Emirates ID copies, photographs where required.

ICP

Emirates ID typing

New, renewal, replacement and lost-card Emirates ID applications on the ICP system, with biometrics appointment guidance where it is required.

Visa & Emirates ID detail Ask about this

Covers

  • New Emirates ID applications
  • Renewal and replacement (lost, damaged, stolen)
  • Data correction and status updates
  • Biometrics appointment guidance
Bring

Passport, visa page, existing Emirates ID for renewals, and the police report for a lost card.

DET

Trade licence & business setup

New trade licences, renewals, amendments, initial approvals and Ejari — from a starter licence to an operating company with a bank account.

Business setup detail Ask about this

Covers

  • New trade licence — mainland and free zone guidance

Passport and visa copies of owners, proposed trade name and activities, tenancy contract or Ejari, and any existing licence for renewals.

MOFA · Embassy

Attestation & MOFA

Educational, commercial and personal documents through embassy and MOFA attestation — the full legalisation chain for use inside or outside the UAE.

Attestation detail Ask about this

Covers

  • Degree, diploma, marksheet and school certificates
  • Marriage, birth and police clearance certificates
  • Powers of attorney, MOA, invoices and agreements
  • Embassy attestation and MOFA stamping

Bring

The original document, earlier attestation stamps already completed, and a copy of your passport and visa.

Service questions

If your question is not here, send it on WhatsApp with the document type. You will get the form, the fee and the list of papers in one reply.

Talk to us
I do not know which form I need. Can you tell me?

Yes — that is most of the job. Send a photo of the document or describe the situation, and we will name the form, the authority and the fee before anything starts.

Do you only type, or do you also submit?

Both. Forms are typed to the authority’s format and submitted through the appropriate channel, and you get the receipt and reference number back.

Can you handle a transaction that spans several authorities?

Often. A new company, for example, runs through a trade name, an initial approval, DET licensing, Ejari, then immigration for visas. We will map the order and tell you which step blocks the next.

Do you work in Arabic?

Yes. The office works in Arabic, English, Hindi and Urdu, and every government form is prepared in the language and layout the authority requires.

Tell us what you need typed

Send the document type on WhatsApp and you will get the exact form, the turnaround and a quote — usually within the hour during opening times.

No payment to get a quote. Government fees are always quoted separately.
